speech.characterDefinition: Reusable character · voice and lip sync
speech.definitionHint: Choose a voice and, when needed, configure a 2D mouth or 3D model. Lines and audio belong to each scene. Save changes before preparing lip sync.
speech.characterSaved: Character saved. Model, mouth, eyes and voice are available in other shots.
speech.characterApplied: Character applied. Shot interventions are preserved.
speech.libraryReloaded: Library refreshed. Review the character before saving again.
speech.editCharacterFace: Adjust mouth and eyes in Video 3D
speech.noPreferredVoice: No preferred voice · use existing audio
speech.voiceHint: Qwen3 CustomVoice supports several languages, but none of these nine original voices is native Spanish. Pronunciation and accent vary across languages: listen to a sample before choosing. Voice direction can influence delivery; it does not guarantee a different accent.
speech.existingAudioWins: This line already has audio: reuse it without generating another voice.
speech.explicitGeneration: Only this button generates audio. It uses the literal text, then local Rhubarb calculates lip-sync.
speech.voiceTooLong: Audio lasts {{seconds}} s and does not fit this turn. Extend its end, then apply the already generated audio. Preserved file: {{file}}
speech.textOnlyProduction: Without audio, editable interventions will open. Add audio or generate each line with the character voice inside Video 3D.
speech.previousShot: Return to the previous shot (keep this draft)
speech.soundtrackHint: Played once. Mouths use their own timing; muting this track does not remove lip-sync.
speech.playVoiceHint: Turn off if this voice already belongs to the scene soundtrack. The mouth remains synchronized.
speech.profileSaved: Placement saved for this GLB. Other shots in this workspace can reuse it.
speech.profileLoaded: Placement restored. This scene's voices and timings have not changed.
speech.profileMissing: This model has no saved placement yet.
speech.loadBeforeSave: A saved placement exists. Load it before updating it.
speech.phoneticHint: Rhubarb proposes mouth gestures; it does not identify speakers. Songs work better with isolated vocals: use them as a muted mouth guide while keeping the song on the scene soundtrack.
speech.productionHint: Choose GLBs and existing audio. Prepare a shot in Video 3D without changing the original production or generating models or voices. Speaker timings without timestamps are editable initial suggestions, not word alignment.
speech.twoSpeakers: Use one or two characters per shot. Split interventions for a larger cast.
speech.productionReady: Audio and characters come from your production. Review mouth placement and timing before export; the original has not been replaced.
speech.title: 3D voice and lip-sync
speech.intro: Edit only this selected subject: add lips, choose a voice, then press Play.
speech.chooseModel: First choose a GLB model in this character's card below the viewport.
speech.noFace: Wait for the GLB to load, then retry. Mouth painting needs a mesh with one standard material.
speech.pickVoice: Choose audio (max. 10 min / 32 MB); analyze fragments up to 90 s
speech.amplitudeHint: Volume only opens/closes the mouth: it does not recognize phonemes. Calculate Rhubarb cues for better results.
speech.needsPlacement: Add lips to this subject before previewing its voice on the model.
speech.facePackHint: Bundled faces for a TV-head screen: visemes and expressions. Experimental.
speech.expressionHoldHint: Vowels only change the mouth. This expression stays on the whole line unless you add expression cues.
speech.facePackMakerHint: Cube-front faces and lips are built in Character Creator: prompts, stills, then a 9×6 pack with locked skin color.
speech.adjustHint: X: left/right; Y: up/down; Z: depth. Face the model forward (+Z), adjust width/height, then Play. The GLB stays intact.
speech.audioBlocked: Voice playback failed. Check the file, then Pause and Play; export reports audio failures.
speech.reviewPlacement: Review the mouth position and size on this model.
speech.manualPlacement: No head landmark found. Adjust this starting position using Mouth X/Y/Z and Width/Height.
speech.referencesHint: Applies placement to this subject. Review the fit after using another character’s reference.
speech.characterLibraryAdvanced: Advanced: reusable characters and preferred voice
speech.microphoneUnavailable: Microphone recording needs HTTPS or localhost and a supported browser. You can use the example or upload audio here.
speech.microphoneDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser and retry.
speech.recordingFailed: Recording failed. Check the microphone and try again.
speech.pickLips: Place with a click on the face
speech.pickHint: Click the mouth on the selected subject. Escape cancels.
speech.pickMissed: Click the selected model’s face, not the background.

timeline.title: Gesture timeline
timeline.clocks: Source time is the audio file. Offset skips its start. Scene time is start + source − offset.
timeline.noAudio: Add a voice to see the waveform. Imported cues can still be edited.

isolation.label: Isolate vocals before calculating lips
isolation.ready: Installed BS-RoFormer · CPU. Separates vocals for lip analysis only; original playback stays intact. Up to 90 seconds; processing can take several minutes. No downloads or cloud services.
isolation.missing: Optional model unavailable. Requires installed audio-separator and the BS-RoFormer checkpoint plus YAML in app/ckpts/roformer. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
isolation.error: Could not check the optional model.

speech.optionalModel: 3D model (optional; not required for voice or 2D characters)
speech.need2dImage: For 2D lip sync, add an image and save the character. You can do this in Characters or from its reference in Series Lab.

voiceAudition.hint: Uses this voice and its current direction. Choosing a voice does not generate audio. This button creates a short recording in HocusPocus; no character save or mouth setup is needed.

customVoice.add: Add your own voice: import or record
customVoice.name: Voice name
customVoice.hint: Use a clean sample of one speaker, without music or other voices. Import or record 3–30 seconds, then enter exactly what it says. The model will use that voice to read new dialogue.
customVoice.recordHint: Up to 30 seconds are saved. You can read a 5–15 second sentence and copy it into the transcript.
customVoice.transcriptPlaceholder: Enter the same words heard in the audio. This is not the dialogue to generate.
customVoice.saveHint: Save the whole character to keep this voice. You can select it for other characters; new or regenerated shots will use that configuration.
customVoice.incomplete: To preview or save this voice, add its name, an audio sample, and its exact transcript.
customVoice.voiceFileSize: Choose a nonempty audio file up to 20 MB.
customVoice.voiceFileDecode: The browser could not decode this audio. Try WAV or MP3.
customVoice.voiceFileDuration: The sample must last 3–30 seconds. Trim the audio and keep the exact transcript of that segment.
customVoice.microphoneUnavailable: Browsers only allow the microphone on HTTPS or localhost. Open HocusPocus at one of those addresses, or import an audio file here.

creative-rose-orbit-motion.title: Velvet Orbit
creative-rose-orbit-motion.description: Animated outer space behind an oval opening. Every detail of the pink room stays still.

creative-glass-orchard-motion.title: The Orchard House
creative-glass-orchard-motion.description: Leaves and petals behind two window panes. The central frame, wall and floor remain static.

creative-amber-ice-motion.title: Window on the Thaw
creative-amber-ice-motion.description: Snow and clouds beyond an amber portal. Static architecture with independent depth.

creative-coral-radio-motion.title: Tidal Radio
creative-coral-radio-motion.description: Waves behind five window panes. Turquoise frames, interior and characters remain separate layers.

creative-cobalt-crater-motion.title: Core Observatory
creative-cobalt-crater-motion.description: Animated lava beyond an observatory window. Frame, interior and characters stay on independent layers.

dark-living-sleeping-titan.title: The Sleeping Titan
dark-living-sleeping-titan.description: Ivory and moss: a lone knight faces a mountain-sized guardian beyond an ancient arch.

dark-living-bell-of-ash.title: The Ash Bell
dark-living-bell-of-ash.description: A charred bell tower opens onto black ash dunes and slow gold embers.

dark-living-antler-moon.title: Moon Among Antlers
dark-living-antler-moon.description: Black roots frame a moonlit stag, rippling water and drifting silver mist.

dark-living-drowned-king.title: The Drowned King
dark-living-drowned-king.description: Waves roll around an enormous crowned head beyond a green sea palace.

dark-living-red-pilgrim.title: The Red Pilgrim
dark-living-red-pilgrim.description: A red sandstone portal frames a distant giant in windblown terracotta dunes.

dark-living-last-aqueduct.title: The Last Aqueduct
dark-living-last-aqueduct.description: White ruins, silver waterfalls and a guardian carved into a blue mountain chasm.

dark-living-ember-heart.title: Heart of Embers
dark-living-ember-heart.description: An obsidian sanctuary opens onto the glowing heart of a volcanic mountain.

dark-living-violet-oracle.title: The Violet Oracle
dark-living-violet-oracle.description: Amethyst and bone frame giant luminous spirits above a violet valley.

dark-living-winter-shoulder.title: On Winter’s Shoulder
dark-living-winter-shoulder.description: A frozen fortress looks tiny on the shoulder of an ancient ice guardian.

dark-living-thorn-crown.title: The Thorn Crown
dark-living-thorn-crown.description: Dark thorns frame crimson flowers and an immense crown on a distant hill.

dark-living-black-tide.title: The Black Tide
dark-living-black-tide.description: Ivory stone frames slow turquoise waves above a hidden leviathan.

dark-living-golden-ruin.title: The Golden Ruin
dark-living-golden-ruin.description: A bronze observatory looks onto a golden sun inside a monumental stone ring.

dark-living-hollow-saint.title: The Hollow Saint
dark-living-hollow-saint.description: Clouds pass through a hollow giant between distant grey mountain peaks.

dark-living-fungal-throne.title: The Mycelium Throne
dark-living-fungal-throne.description: Roots and burial stone frame a throne of glowing mushrooms and drifting spores.

dark-living-storm-bridge.title: The Storm Bridge
dark-living-storm-bridge.description: A gothic gatehouse frames a broken bridge and distant violet storm clouds.

dark-living-sand-library.title: Names Beneath the Sand
dark-living-sand-library.description: An ochre archive opens onto giant stone tablets and dunes of moving sand.

dark-living-jade-dragon.title: The Jade Dragon
dark-living-jade-dragon.description: A jade pavilion overlooks a petrified dragon, waterfalls and drifting mountain mist.

dark-living-moon-grave.title: The Moon’s Tomb
dark-living-moon-grave.description: A basalt burial chamber frames a fallen moon and slow luminous snow.

dark-living-copper-trees.title: The Copper Forest
dark-living-copper-trees.description: Black roots frame copper leaves and a stone sentinel hidden in teal forest mist.

dark-living-final-gate.title: The Last Giant’s Gate
dark-living-final-gate.description: A final knight stands before the giant that holds a broken gate above the horizon.

dark-still-salt-sea.title: Salt Above the Sea
dark-still-salt-sea.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-still-flame.title: The Motionless Flame
dark-still-still-flame.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-winter-vigil.title: The White Vigil
dark-still-winter-vigil.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-moth-moon.title: The Moth and the Moon
dark-still-moth-moon.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-ivory-fire.title: Ivory Against Fire
dark-still-ivory-fire.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-two-distances.title: Two Distances
dark-still-two-distances.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-copper-night.title: Copper Over Violet
dark-still-copper-night.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-still-time-wounds.title: Time Has Weight
dark-still-time-wounds.description: Fixed camera, animated atmosphere and independently editable foreground layers.

dark-motion-knight-passage.title: The Ash Walker
dark-motion-knight-passage.description: An independently animated walking knight over a moving misty passage.

dark-motion-knight-embers.title: Toward the Embers
dark-motion-knight-embers.description: The same walking performance in front of molten lava and static architecture.

creative-motion-skate-coast.title: Salt and Speed
creative-motion-skate-coast.description: An illustrated skater above a moving turquoise coast and coral cliffs.

creative-motion-skate-neon.title: The City Passes
creative-motion-skate-neon.description: A moving jacket and board over an independently sliding violet city.

creative-motion-skate-clouds.title: Cloud Road
creative-motion-skate-clouds.description: A longboard over impossible blue stone and slower peach clouds.

creative-motion-skate-portal.title: The Sea Beyond
creative-motion-skate-portal.description: A PSX actor, static stonework and a moving sea horizon behind the arch.

pixel-tv-wall.title: TV wall
pixel-tv-wall.description: Two banks of stacked CRT televisions in a dark gallery. Every screen plays your recording; the tubes light the wet floor and the room shifts from cold to neon.

pixel-moon-lake.title: Moon lake
pixel-moon-lake.description: Hand-drawn pixel night over a still lake: a haloed moon, aurora, shooting stars and a rippling reflection, gliding from midnight through aurora and dawn to sunset.

pixel-tv-lake.title: TVs on the lake
pixel-tv-lake.description: Old televisions standing in a pixel lake at night, glowing with your recording and reflected in the water while the sky cycles through neon and eclipse.

pixel-aurora-peaks.title: Aurora peaks
pixel-aurora-peaks.description: Snowy pixel mountains rise out of a frozen lake under curtains of aurora; the light slides from polar green to icy day and back to night.

pixel-neon-city.title: Neon harbour
pixel-neon-city.description: A pixel skyline over dark water: windows switch on and off by colour cycling and the whole city glows back from the harbour as the night turns neon.

pixel-desert-sun.title: Desert sun
pixel-desert-sun.description: Mesas and dunes under a huge striped sun; the sand glows from dusk to sunset and cools into a starry desert night.

pixel-lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
pixel-lighthouse.description: A sea cliff with a lighthouse whose beam sweeps the night over choppy water, from storm to moonlight and dawn.

pixel-firefly-forest.title: Firefly forest
pixel-firefly-forest.description: Tall pines around a forest lake, fireflies pulsing among the trees and in the reeds, under a green aurora.

pixel-planet-rise.title: Planet rise
pixel-planet-rise.description: A ringed planet rises over jagged alien peaks and a violet sea; its cloud bands drift by colour cycling while the light slides from alien teal to vapor neon.

pixel-night-train.title: Midnight train
pixel-night-train.description: A lit night train crosses a stone viaduct over a moonlit lake, its windows glowing on the water, as midnight slowly turns to dawn.

pixel-storm-lake.title: Storm on the lake
pixel-storm-lake.description: Rain lashes a dark pixel lake while lightning strikes the far ranges; every bolt lights the whole painted world for an instant and its thunder rolls in on cue.

pixel-volcano.title: Volcano
pixel-volcano.description: Rivers of lava run down a volcano by pure colour cycling, the crater glows and breathes smoke and embers, and the red spills across the sea under an eclipsed moon.

pixel-drive-in.title: Drive-in
pixel-drive-in.description: A desert drive-in under the stars: a huge screen plays your recording, rows of parked cars flash their brake lights, and the film light washes over the cars, sand and mesas.

pixel-cherry-garden.title: Cherry garden
pixel-cherry-garden.description: Blossoming cherry trees round a still pond, a pagoda with lit windows under a snowy peak, stone lanterns glowing and petals drifting down as the pink dusk turns to night.

pixel-coral-reef.title: Coral reef
pixel-coral-reef.description: Under the sea: shafts of sunlight shimmer down from a rippling surface, kelp sways over coral, two schools of fish cross in opposite directions and plankton glints, from a bright lagoon to the deep blue.

pixel-balloons.title: Balloons at dawn
pixel-balloons.description: Hot-air balloons drift and bob over a misty valley as the sun comes up, near ones large and slow, far ones small, all mirrored in the lake while dawn warms into sunset.

pixel-night-fair.title: Night fair
pixel-night-fair.description: A Ferris wheel turns over the harbour, its bulbs chasing round by colour cycling while the gondolas hang upright, striped tents glow under strings of lights and the whole fair shimmers in the water.

pixel-snow-village.title: Snowy village
pixel-snow-village.description: A snowed-in village at dusk: lit windows, a church steeple, smoke curling from the chimneys and skaters gliding across a frozen lake that mirrors it all as the snow keeps falling.

pixel-waterfall.title: Waterfall
pixel-waterfall.description: A waterfall pours between mossy cliffs by pure colour cycling, foam boils at its foot, a rainbow hangs in the spray and the jungle light turns to dusk and night.

pixel-orbit.title: Orbit
pixel-orbit.description: High above a planet: its curved horizon glows with atmosphere, city lights dot the night side, nebula clouds breathe among dense stars and a space station and tumbling asteroids drift by.

pixel-tulip-fields.title: Tulip fields
pixel-tulip-fields.description: Rows of red, yellow, pink and violet tulips run to the horizon in true perspective while windmills turn their sails against a sunset that fades through dusk to dawn.

pixel-neon-alley.title: Neon alley
pixel-neon-alley.description: A narrow street in the rain between tall façades: lit windows, fire escapes, shopfronts and neon signs that buzz and flicker, all mirrored in the wet ground, with the city glowing at the far end.

pixel-castle-fireworks.title: Castle fireworks
pixel-castle-fireworks.description: A castle on its hill with lit windows and banners while fireworks rise and burst in rings of embers that sag and fade, every burst mirrored in the lake below.

pixel-glow-tide.title: Glowing tide
pixel-glow-tide.description: A night beach where every wave glows blue as it breaks: bands of bioluminescent surf roll in across the wet sand by colour cycling, under a moon mirrored in the sea.

pixel-lantern-festival.title: Lantern festival
pixel-lantern-festival.description: Hundreds of paper lanterns rise slowly from a still lake at dusk, swaying as they climb and flickering warm, near ones faster than far ones, all mirrored in the water.

animationFitHint: Play the remaining animation once over the current shot duration (0.1–4× speed). Apply again if you change the duration or start time.
invalidDocument: Could not open: this is not a valid 3D shot file.

travel.title: Travel through the scene
travel.help: The transform panel sets the starting position. Define the destination here; the path lasts for the shot.
travel.floor: Use image as a floor texture
travel.typingHelp: Keyboard gesture for compatible characters. Use it with the programmer room template and keep the character close to the desk.

framing.title: Subject framing
framing.help: Follow a point on the subject. Adjust framing to your GLB; models without a head bone use their height.
framing.head: Head

screens.title: Media screen
screens.attach: Put a face / screen on this character
screens.clockHelp: Video follows the scene clock. Its audio is muted.
screens.failed: The screen could not load. Check the mesh and media file.
screens.transparentHelp: Use an image or video with an alpha channel, such as transparent WebM. This keeps existing transparency; it does not remove an opaque video background.
screens.loopDetailsHelp: Back-and-forth playback avoids a reset jump and reverses the motion. Use elapsed time to continue the same animation in the next shot.
screens.applyAllDone: All screens now play this recording

library.name: Scene name
library.help: Choose a saved Video3D scene. Choosing replaces the current shot; save it first to keep your edits. JSON import and export remain available.
library.saved: Scene saved to this workspace. Open scene to load it again.
library.changed: The scene changed while loading. Choose it again to replace the current scene.
library.previewUnavailable: Wait for the 3D preview to load before saving.

cinematic.title: Cinematic environment
cinematic.help: Choose a background image and select Full scene background in its Surface control. The image fills the frame; it is an illustrated backdrop, not 3D architecture.
cinematic.idleHelp: Uses the selected animation at its start offset with subtle body movement. Choose a relaxed frame of an idle or walking clip; no animation is transferred between rigs.
cinematic.floorSourceHeight: Lower backdrop portion used as floor

imageLook.title: Image appearance
imageLook.colorKeyHelp: Select the leftover background color to clear enclosed gaps and edges. Start with low tolerance to preserve details. Applies to this image or moving layer; you can turn it off at any time.

windows.title: Transparent windows ({{count}})
windows.help: Click around the opening and choose Save window. Drag points to refine the outline. Place a video layer behind it: the frame, wall and props keep their original image. The source image is unchanged.

poses.help: Each pose holds for its interval while the environment keeps moving. Use transparent PNG cutouts; adjust height and position to keep the character size and ground contact consistent.

pixelWorld.title: Pixel light
pixelWorld.help: The world is painted in palette slots: changing the palette relights every pixel, like colour-cycling art.

scene.title: World elements
scene.reimagineHelp: Paints the same world with a new layout of ridges, trees, stars and buildings.
scene.lightHelp: The key light comes from the sun or moon: move it to relight actors and TVs from that side.
scene.reset: Back to the world as designed
